Excellent service and food
Mar 2026 • Family
We had a wonderful dining experience at Tempus Fugit during our stay. A very special thank you to Chef Lokesh, who went above and beyond to make our experience truly memorable.
Not only did he prepare excellent breakfasts for us each morning, but he also kindly came in especially to prepare dinner for us. Everything he made was delicious and prepared with great care and attention.
Chef Lokesh’s warmth, professionalism and genuine hospitality really stood out. He took the time to engage with us and ensure we had a wonderful experience. Our stay would not have been the same without him.
We would also like to thank the servers Chan, Uyen and especially Lucy, who took wonderful care of us throughout our visits. Special special special thanks as well to Kwang for the excellent service.

Unfortunately, several interactions with a server named Truc was disappointing, as the service on each occasion felt dismissive and less welcoming.

Overall, Chef Lokesh and the wider team are a real credit to the restaurant, and we are very grateful for the effort they made to make our visit so special.

Feel like I was punked
Jan 2026 • Couples
Tried their promotional “black truffle set dinner.” It was a four course meal- the first course was an egg yolk with cream sauce and a facoccia bread the size of my pinky to dip in. Once the bread was gone I guess they expected you to spoon the rest of the egg yolk mixture into your mouth? Gross. Next course was a tagliatelle that tasted like straight pepper. The “black truffle” had zero taste. If anything, it tasted like plastic. The main course of tenderloin was literally two bites (maybe 3), with 4 asparagus. Again zero flavor to the truffle. The dessert was a pear concoction with truffle ice cream which tasted hugely of truffle. Very odd and did not pair well at all. Horrible service was at the restaurant for over 2 hours constantly flagging staff down.

What a wonderful evening at Tempus!
Dec 2025 • Couples
Every dish left a memorable impression, beautifully presented and full of fresh, vibrant flavors. The Dalat vegetables and burrata salad were a refreshing start — light, colorful, and perfectly balanced. Beyond the food, the warmth and attentiveness of the team made the experience even more special. Thank you Chef Khoa, William, Nhi, and the entire Tempus staff for such thoughtful service and a truly enjoyable night.

We’ll definitely return with our family when we have the chance. A fantastic dining experience from start to finish!
